headline._: A quiet day. The newsroom's agents were back and checked the backlog; no new fact moves the story, and still no organisation confirms a compromise.
headline.exec: Nothing new for you. Still no organisation says it was hit; the fix is out.
headline.general: Nothing new for you. If someone runs your website, ask them if it is updated.
headline.security: Nothing moved the measures. Dream Research's report stays reported, not confirmed: no Unit 42 or vendor primary statement is captured.
headline.engineer: Nothing new to install. Confirm the fixed version is what is running.
headline.journalist: Back to watching after the weekend gap. Three batches reviewed, no catches; the compromise stamps stay at 09:42 UTC on 30 October.
headline.researcher: 727 sources by the 18:15 UTC export; none published on the day among those captured. One source dated 1 November (digitech, offline sites) is captured and not yet reviewed.
